title: FolderLoad::Merging holds no RequestId and its answer is matched by purpose+folder id
trigger: Edit a folder, change it elsewhere so the cached spec is stale, press Save: Merging is entered and upkeep polls has_purpose_for_folder(GetChatFolder, folder_id) and folder_specs.error(folder_id) every frame instead of waiting on the request that Merging sent
effect: No visible bug today (fetch_chat_folder dedups per folder and clears the error on send), but a GetChatFolder sent by another box (Share folder) for the same folder is taken as the merge's own answer, and the merge cannot tell its request from another
fix: FolderLoad::Merging { request: RequestId } set from fetch_chat_folder's Ok(Some(id)) (or the pending extra), settled by waits_for(id)

title: Closing the Add folder box while Adding drops the stage and the add's outcome is never shown
trigger: Open an addlist link, tick chats, press Add, then close the box (X/Esc) before TDLib answers
effect: close_folder_invite only cancels a Checking request; the Adding request stays in the session, its answer sits unclaimed in dialog_answers (ring of 16) and no toast says whether the folder was added or the add failed

title: Closing the Share folder box during a link save/delete loses the answer and any error
trigger: Share folder box, press Save/Create/Delete link (LinkOp::Saving), close the box before the answer
effect: settle_folder_share only runs while the box is open, so a failure (error line) or limit hit is never shown anywhere; the link list silently stays as it was

title: A second topic action overwrites the Waiting stage of the first
trigger: Choose Mark mentions read on a topic, then before TDLib answers choose Unpin all messages on another
effect: ChatUi::topic_action holds one Waiting{request,done}; the second action replaces it, so the first one's success toast never shows and its answer stays in topic_action_answers

title: GifTab::Asked holds no request: 'asked' is a flag beside the session's GifPanel loading state
trigger: A window sets GifTab::Asked(wanted) when it sends show_saved_gifs/search_gifs; the answer is read from the shared GifPanel by comparing GifWanted::shown(panel) to the wanted section, not by a RequestId held in the tab
effect: No bug traced today; another window's search or a failed answer is inferred from the shared list, and Wants/Asked only stop upkeep from asking again
fix: GifTab::Asked { wanted, request: RequestId } settled by the answer to that request

title: FieldStage::Away/Typing is a 'focus taken' flag derived from ShowingView each frame
trigger: PasswordField::keep maps ShowingView to Away/Typing only to focus the field once per idle phase
effect: No bug; two-variant enum beside the caller's real stage (PasswordView/ShowingView)
fix: fold the focus latch into the caller's stage (Idle { focused }) or drop it for a Mount-style one-shot
